replace:

why: `back()` claims to have consumed a Back when nothing was open. Every caller that falls through on `false` -- Escape to the session's pause hotkey, issue #319's gamepad Back to its own pause action -- would stop at the Main Menu and do nothing. hud.navigation.test.ts (244): the `hud.back()` and gameplay-entry cases, the first Escape case and both mirror cases, each of which asserts `back()` is false once nothing is open. Pinned by name since the hud suite was split (issue #511); its killers live in hud.navigation.test.ts.
